spec.title: Straight line y = a·x + b (template fixture)
spec.subtitle: Neutral demo used only to test the template. Not from any paper.

idea.what: A straight line is set by its slope a and intercept b.
idea.why: Many relationships are linear over small ranges.

controls.label: Slope a
controls.help: Try 0 to make the line flat.

explorations.title: Flat line
explorations.observe: The line is flat and the root is undefined.
explorations.why: With a = 0, y never changes, so it never crosses 0 unless b = 0.

explorations.title: Uneven weights
explorations.change: Put all weight on the last sample.
explorations.observe: The weighted mean equals the last x.
explorations.why: A weight of 1 on one item ignores the rest.

limitation.text: Real data is rarely exactly linear.

our_simplifications: Everything here is a made-up example.
